a.lede: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.
a.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits

b.lede: France's national blood service has confirmed that a cyberattack targeting a refrigeration equipment provider raised temperature and defrost settings at three of its facilities, threatening stored blood products. [...]
b.title: Cyberattack disrupts blood storage refrigeration systems in France
